items.quote: we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration
items.statement: Aspirational EBIT margin of 16-17% (management says this is not formal guidance)
items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

items.quote: We are confident of getting these approvals in over the next several weeks
items.statement: RBI and related approvals for the Nagarro combination expected within several weeks
items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

items.quote: we will be raising USD 1.25 billion in terms of both debt and equity
items.statement: Raise USD 1.25 billion of debt and equity for the Nagarro acquisition financing (USD 450 million equity-linked)
items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

items.quote: we are expecting one-time expenses to the tune of approximately $50 million spread over three to four quarters
items.statement: One-time Nagarro transaction expenses of about USD 50 million over 3-4 quarters
items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

items.quote: we expect an incremental amount ranging between USD 25 to 30 million
items.statement: Further USD 25-30 million of Nagarro transaction costs over the next two quarters (Q&A later says 3-4 quarters)
items.speaker: Tailwinds

items.quote: We expect in the next 4 to 6 weeks, max, let's say 8 weeks
items.statement: Close Nagarro deal (after Austria and Spain FDI approvals) within 4-8 weeks
items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

items.quote: we will need about 5 to 6 months to optimistically bring the 2 companies together
items.statement: Merger squeeze-out and integration of the two companies in about 5-6 months after closing
items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

tone.label: cautious
tone.why: Management says it does not give forward-looking guidance and frames the 16-17% margin as an aspiration, while deal timing depends on approvals that will come when they come (p19-41-1, p20-49-1).
